prompt: A device left on standby uses 10 W all day, every day, for a year of 365 days. How many kWh does it use in the year?
explanation: 10 W = 0.01 kW. Hours in a year of full days: 24 x 365 = 8,760. Energy: 0.01 x 8,760 = 87.6 kWh, even though the device is never actively used.
